senses.gloss:
धित a.
—1 Placed, bestowed.
—2 Satisfied, pleased.

धीत a.
—1 Sucked, drunk; see धे.
—2 Reflected upon, thought about.
—3 Propitiated. ━n. (pl.) thoughts, meditations.

धीतिः f.
—1 Drinking, sucking.
—2 Thirst.
—3 Ved. The fingers.
—4 Thought, notion.
—5 Devotion.
—6 Disrespect, disregard.
